meta.name: Touch Me Not
meta.description: A guy whose touch has supernatural abilities builds a team to solve complex cases, unaware they're being hunted by an enigmatic murderer.

videos.title: The Fire that Changed Everything
videos.overview: A terrible fire at Maruthi Apartments links Raghav and Rishi. Years later, while helping Devika investigate a hospital fire through his psychometry, Rishi meets Megha.

videos.title: Secrets Beneath the Flames
videos.overview: Rishi and Megha expose a corrupt teacher, and Raghav tracks a key witness in the Godavari Hospital fire. When Megha's past is exposed, Rishi offers her help, only to be shut out.

videos.title: Suitcase Murder
videos.overview: Three years later, Rishi reunites with Megha and stumbles across a body in a suitcase. Meanwhile, Raghav, still haunted by a witness' murder, spots a hooded figure lurking nearby.

videos.title: Raghavs Nightmare Returns
videos.overview: Raghav asks for Megha's help to improve Rishi's psychometry. Rishi spots the hooded stalker following Raghav and follows him in return.

videos.title: Visions of the Victim
videos.overview: As Rishi recovers, Megha helps him refine his psychometry skills. The victim in the suitcase murder is identified, and it's connected to a previous case.

videos.title: Unmasking the Past
videos.overview: The cat-and-mouse game between Raghav and his stalker escalates. Rishi and Megha infiltrate Kabir's company, and Devika uncovers Raghav's past. What will unfold next?
